t.GLYCERIN.agn: It is not in the annexes of the EU Cosmetics Regulation; there is no specific limit or labelling rule. In food it appears as E422.
t.GLYCERIN.eff.0: In the EU there is no health warning or usage limit specific to this substance. No substance-level scientific assessment has been read for this entry yet.
t.GLYCERIN.summary: The most common humectant in cosmetics.
t.GLYCERIN.what: Binds water to keep the skin moist; also used as a solvent and to adjust viscosity.
